verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's subscriptions docs list automatic retries for rejected subscription payments, which covers the core retry part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents smart or configurable dunning logic or customer recovery emails. Missing for 10: smart dunning (configurable or intelligent retry schedules), recovery/dunning email notifications, retry-depth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails

citations.quote: Automatic retries if a payment is rejected.
Customizable billing frequency: weekly, monthly, or yearly.
